_comment: The bootstrap instance. It declares two directories — `skills/` and `workflows/` — because discovery reads declarations rather than walking the tree, and an undeclared directory is not this instance's graph however many files sit in it. TWO processes live here and exactly one of them is an ENTRY POINT: `workflows/initialize-harness.bpmn`. An Initiator that has read README.md is at its start event with nowhere else to begin. `workflows/log-message.bpmn` is the other, and it is an independent SUB-PROCESS — reached only by a callActivity from a step, never started — so it does not compete with the first for being the thing you begin. The constraint was never 'one file'; it is that there is one place to start. Cat-harness is composed ON TOP of this rather than being its parent, which is why nothing here may import from it.
name: bootstrap
description: The graph an agent reads before it knows what this repository is.

assets.title: AGENTS.md — bootstrap
assets.description: Phase one of two. Valid with nothing installed: no skills, no knowledge graph, no MCP, no beans. The default behaviour of initialisation is to copy this file, and the last bootstrap step re-enters through the installed harness, which is what supplies phase two. No `source` because this is the origin — an absent source means authored here, which is a different fact from an upstream that cannot be reached.

assets.title: bootstrap
assets.description: The flow, with every term linked to the schema that defines it. Self-documenting on GitHub: a person landing on the directory reads the thing itself rather than a pointer to a site.

_directories_comment: ONE entry, and it is a subdirectory rather than `bootstrap/` itself. `isSkillMd` is declaration-over-location: a markdown file that does NOT declare `$schema:` is a skill. README.md and AGENTS.md declare neither, so a graph rooted at `bootstrap/` would count this instance's two DECLARED ASSETS as skill nodes — the instance has already said what those files are, and a scan would contradict its own declaration. Keeping the graph one level down means the two mechanisms cannot collide. Declared explicitly rather than relying on DEFAULT_DIRECTORIES: a declaration that exists is honoured as written, so defaults do not apply to an instance that declares anything at all.

directories.description: The bootstrap PROCESSES — `initialize-harness.bpmn`, the one an actor starts, and `log-message.bpmn`, an independent sub-process any step may call. Declared because discovery reads declarations rather than walking the tree: until 2026-09-19 `findBpmnDirs` found this directory by WALKING from the repository root, which also walked it into folio-assistant's graph (88 references to `Process_Bootstrap` in `_kg/folio-assistant.jsonld`, measured). A separate id from `cat-harness`, because overrides match on id and `skills/` already holds that one — reusing it would replace bootstrap's skills with its workflows.
